spots.text: IN CASE OF FALLING, YOU ARE ALREADY HALFWAY.

secrets.name: The Room Under the Bridge
secrets.text: Over the side, down an iron ladder and through a hatch: a plank room hung under the span on chains, swaying very slightly. Someone slept here, with the void on every side and a lamp for company.

meta.label: The Bridge over the Void
meta.blurb: One bridge, one person wide, across a gap in the library that goes down further than the lamps do. Its parapets are bookcases. People stop in the middle to browse, which seems brave.
